decisions.reason: As a Magento shop template it fits the firm's e-commerce hosting clientele, but template products are less central than services and can be dropped if demand stays niche.
A responsive website template is close to the firm's web project business and broad customer base, so it is likely to remain unless uptake is clearly weak.
Premium customer support is highly consistent with the firm's core positioning around expert managed service and 24/7 help, making discontinuation unlikely.
A software version management tool builds directly on the firm's technical hosting and administration capabilities and was important enough to receive its own page.
The data processing contract tool is more distant from the core hosting offer and is the most plausible candidate to be discontinued so resources can be focused on core platform and support products.
